scripts.build: BUILD_ENTRY=content vite build && BUILD_ENTRY=background vite build && BUILD_ENTRY=offscreen vite build && BUILD_ENTRY=sandbox vite build && vite build --config vite.sidepanel.config.ts
scripts.build:dev: BUILD_DEV=1 BUILD_ENTRY=content vite build && BUILD_DEV=1 BUILD_ENTRY=background vite build && BUILD_DEV=1 BUILD_ENTRY=offscreen vite build && BUILD_DEV=1 BUILD_ENTRY=sandbox vite build && BUILD_DEV=1 vite build --config vite.sidepanel.config.ts
scripts.dev: npm run build:dev && concurrently "node scripts/reload-server.mjs" "NODE_ENV=development BUILD_DEV=1 WATCH=1 vite build --watch" "BUILD_DEV=1 WATCH=1 vite build --config vite.sidepanel.config.ts --watch"
